317:t_1:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「...Briefing under the night sky. It reminds me of our time in $$ヘルマジスタン$$.」

317:t_1:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That was a rough situation too, but it was a lot better than this.」

317:t_1:5.en:
$$ノーマン$$
「I apologize that dinner could not meet everyone's wishes, either.」

317:t_1:6.en:
$n
「Not at all, $$ノーマン$$. It was really delicious.」

317:t_1:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's right. Even if we didn't have the same ingredients, it's a world of difference compared to $n's survival cooking.」

317:t_1:8.en:
$n
「That's harsh, Miss $$スズネ$$... I worked hard on it with no seasoning or anything...」

317:t_1:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「S-sorry...! It just slipped out as a figure of speech...」

317:t_1:10.en:
$$カレン$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$... For that whole week alone together, you ate $n's home cooking the entire time?」

317:t_1:11.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Y-yes... We decided it was better not to use the $$ジェニオン$$'s survival kit, in case we needed it for something...」

317:t_1:12.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I thought there'd be sweet romance with an older woman on a remote island in the middle of nowhere... but the world doesn't quite work out that nicely.」

317:t_1:13.en:
$$スザク$$
「You weren't just repairing the $$ジェニオン$$, you were cooking too. That must have been tough, $n.」

317:t_1:15.en:
$$スズネ$$
「W-wait a moment! That makes it sound like I did nothing at all!」

317:t_1:16.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Well... I don't have your knowledge of wild plants, $n, and I couldn't catch birds or fish either, but...」

317:t_1:18.en:
$$ノーマン$$
「It's all right, $n. Taste aside, your sincerity has reached Miss $$スズネ$$.」

317:t_1:19.en:
$n
「If that's just consolation, I don't need it...」

317:t_1:20.en:
$$ノーマン$$
「As a butler, I hold it as my creed never to tell a lie.」

317:t_1:21.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Though the sheep was a liar.」

317:t_1:25.en:
$n
「Thank you, $$ノーマン$$. I'll... work on improving my cooking.」

317:t_1:27.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm truly sorry, $n. I... really was no help at all, wasn't I.」

317:t_1:28.en:
$n
「It's all right, Miss $$スズネ$$. Just having you there was a help to me.」

317:t_1:32.en:
$$スザク$$
(Somehow... it's like the guardian relationship has been reversed...)

317:t_1:33.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
(That frail little boy has grown up.)

317:t_1:34.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We've finished repairing each unit with the materials $$ＡＧ$$ procured, but we can't stay like this forever.」

317:t_1:35.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「What we can do here is only emergency treatment, after all. They will need maintenance by proper mechanics.」

317:t_1:37.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「...As I already told you, the $$ミスリル$$ facilities, including $$メリダ島$$, were attacked by $$アマルガム$$ and destroyed.」

317:t_1:38.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Unfortunately, there is no facility or organization in this vicinity that would take us in.」

317:t_1:39.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That said, we can't keep relying on the $$ＥＸ－１０$$'s care forever.」

317:t_1:40.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Besides, $$カン・ユー$$ knows where we are.」

317:t_1:41.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「With $c scattered, the destruction of $$ミスリル$$ is a heavy blow.」

317:t_1:42.en:
$$カレン$$
「First $$宗介$$ and $$かなめ$$, and now even $$テッサ$$...」

317:t_1:45.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$宗介$$ and $$テッサ$$ are tough as nails. They won't kick the bucket that easily.」

317:t_1:46.en:
$$マオ$$
「That girl has the $$ダナン$$, after all. I'm sure she's escaped from $$メリダ島$$.」

317:t_1:47.en:
$$スザク$$
「You believe in her, don't you.」

317:t_1:48.en:
$$マオ$$
「Yeah. She's our commanding officer, our goddess, and our queen.」

317:t_1:49.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Regrettably, we can't afford to worry about others, either. Let's first think about surviving ourselves.」

317:t_1:50.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What about joining up with the $$連邦軍$$?」

317:t_1:51.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Since it's unknown how deeply $$クロノ$$ has penetrated the current $$連邦軍$$, that would be dangerous.」

317:t_1:52.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Right... If things go badly, we'd be walking unprotected straight into the enemy's trap.」

317:t_1:53.en:
$n
「To reach the Far East Branch, where we'd be sure to be safe, we'd have to cross $$サイデリアル$$ territory...」

317:t_1:54.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And a major problem is that our operating funds are nearly exhausted.」

317:t_1:56.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$c had sponsors and supporters, starting with the $$連邦軍$$, but in this situation we can't make contact with them.」

317:t_1:57.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Until we get through the present situation, we have to find a source of funds on our own.」

317:t_1:58.en:
$$スザク$$
「To think a problem like this would come up now...」

317:t_1:61.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$クロウ・ブルースト$$... A member of $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$, the guy who was always whining about paying off his debts.」

317:t_1:62.en:
$n
「The Reactor of the $$揺れる天秤$$... I'd heard about him, but he really has it rough, huh...」

317:t_1:63.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「I hear the town of $$ナムサク$$, several dozen kilometers from here, has an arena.」

317:t_1:64.en:
$$カレン$$
「An arena... You mean like $$バトリング$$?」

317:t_1:65.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Exactly. Fights between small machines like ASs and ATs are turned into a spectacle, and the spectators bet money on them.」

317:t_1:68.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「The arena in $$ナムサク$$ is one of the places that have long been marked as a venue for the private purposes of a large-scale organization.」

317:t_1:70.en:
$$クルツ$$
「We can't just barge into a place like that in our current situation.」

317:t_1:71.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Besides, the $$バトリング$$ prize money isn't enough to serve as a funding source.」

317:t_1:72.en:
$$マオ$$
「If only we could link up with $$ヒイロ$$ and the others, we could probably manage something by brute force...」

317:t_1:73.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...In that case, I have a perfect money-making opportunity.」

317:t_1:76.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not far from here there's a town called $$グルフェー$$, and $$ゴウト$$ and his people are there.」

317:t_1:78.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. It seems they're in a difficult situation, so I think helping them would resolve our problem.」

317:t_1:82.en: ～ $$グルフェー$$ Chamber of Commerce Office ～

317:t_1:83.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「...You saved me, $$ゼロ$$. I never expected you people to take out the bandit gang for us.」

317:t_1:84.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We have circumstances of our own that left us no choice.」

317:t_1:85.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「To think $c would end up scattered... A spacequake is a terrifying thing.」
